return [{ json: { ...j, audit_action: 'logged_' + j.band.toLowerCase() } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({filterGroups: [{filters: [{propertyName: "phone", operator: "EQ", value: $json.phone_normalized}]}, {filters: [{propertyName: "email", operator: "EQ", value: $json.email_normalized}]}], properties: ["email", "phone", "firstname", "lastname"], limit: 10}) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const j = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: {
  lead_id: j.lead_id || '',
  name: j.name || '',
  phone_normalized: j.phone_normalized || '',
  email_normalized: j.email_normalized || '',
  product: j.product || '',
  budget_egp: String(j.budget_egp || ''),
  band: j.band || '',
  score: String(j.score || ''),
  stage_failed: j.stage_failed || 'unknown',
  error_message: String(j.error_message || '').slice(0, 500),
  contact_id: j.contact_id || '',
  deal_id: j.deal_id || '',
  status: 'pending',
  retry_count: '0',
  created_at: new Date().toISOString()
}}];
